files.html:
## Changelog

### Added
- TACZ Fire NPC mode so only configured NPCs are controlled by the mod
- Configurable attack target entity rules with entity ID selection
- Target import/export support
- Target filtering by search, checked state, and mod ID
- Vanilla scoreboard tag-based target conditions
- Same-faction tag targeting option
- Default walking speed control
- NPC core item texture

### Improved
- UI layout and controls
- Target validation to use visible targets
- Performance by limiting target scans to relevant managed NPCs and attack ranges

### Fixed
- Magazine placement issues in armor/offhand slots
- NPC death pose behavior
